text: LA DIEGOL is Marta Diego, a director born and raised in Barcelona. Her work explores everyday life through a contemporary, urban and human lens, with a focus on performance, rhythm and visual storytelling.

With a background in dance and performing arts, movement is central to the way she builds a scene, from the body and camera to the edit. She works closely with actors, creating an environment of trust where performances feel spontaneous and full of personality.
Across advertising and music videos, she brings a cinematic eye to storytelling, always finding emotion in the details.
Her clients include LOEWE, Samsung, CUPRA, FC Barcelona, Burger King, Leroy Merlin and Solgar, among others.
